messages:
customer_acme: Hey team — we started seeing validation failures in our ingestion pipeline after switching to the new model yesterday. Pydantic throws a JSONDecodeError when parsing the 'payload' field from the API. The odd bit: the API returns a JSON where the 'payload' value is a string containing escaped JSON (so we get a string instead of an object). This breaks both our Pydantic models and our Zod-based frontend checks.

Example response we received:
```json
{
  \"id\": \"req_01F...\",
  \"payload\": \"{\\\"userId\\\": 987, \\\"items\\\": [{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"x123\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}], \\\"meta\\\": {\\\"version\\\":\\\"2.0\\\"}}\",\n  \"status\": \"ok\"\n}
```

This used to return payload as an object. Repro steps: call /v1/responses with structured_output enabled (we send json_schema via SDK). Any ideas?

alice_support: Thanks for the report — really helpful example. Which model name/version are you hitting and which SDK/agent version? Also are you passing any streaming/options flags (json_mode, structured_output flags)?

customer_acme: We're calling model: \"redwood/gptx-open-13b:2026-03-08\" via the Node SDK @ 0.9.7. We set structured_output: true and include a json_schema for validation. No custom post-processing. Curl we used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood/gptx-open-13b:2026-03-08\",\"input\":\"...\",\"structured_output\":true,\"json_schema\":{...}}'
```

dev_james: I can reproduce locally — thanks for the sample. Root cause: a streaming fallback path started wrapping completed structured outputs into a single escaped string when a partial text chunk was observed during streaming. That wrapping was intended to avoid broken partial JSON, but we forgot to unescape the payload on the finalization path in the runtime for non-function-calling flows. So the object ends up double-encoded (object -> string).

Workaround: if you control the client, pre-unwrap the field before validation. Example Python snippet:
```py
import json
resp = api.call(...)
if isinstance(resp.get('payload'), str):
    try:
        resp['payload'] = json.loads(resp['payload'])
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        # fallback: keep original and let Pydantic surface error
        pass
# now feed resp['payload'] into Pydantic / Zod
```

Alternatively, set structured_output_v2: true in the request (server-side flag) as a temporary toggle; that route avoids the old streaming fallback.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: PR #2345 (runtime/unescape-structured-output) merged to staging at 2026-03-12T18:40Z. Hotfix rollout planned to prod on 2026-03-13 02:00 UTC (canary first).

alice_support: Can you try the Python snippet or toggle structured_output_v2 and tell us if parsing is unblocked? If it works we can mark this as high priority and notify you when the hotfix goes live.

customer_acme: Tried the json.loads unwrap — that fixed our pipeline. Pydantic validates again and Zod frontend checks pass now. Thanks! :tada:

dev_james: Great — we'll put this on the 2-hour hotfix window and follow up with a patch note. ETA for full release: ~3 hours from now (post-canary), after smoke tests. Patch includes extra unit tests for escaped-structured-output and adds a server-side safety unescape so clients don't need the workaround long-term.

alice_support: I'll add you to the post-release thread and send the incident note once prod is healthy. Apologies for the disruption — we appreciate the repro steps.
